name: Two-Stage Specified Diffusion
definition: A two-stage fine-tuning process to specialize a 2D diffusion model (Stable Diffusion) for a specific target object, gradually learning visual style and identity details.
summary: Two-Stage Specified Diffusion fine-tunes a 2D diffusion model for a target object by decoupling style learning from identity preservation, preventing overfitting to artifacts in intermediate generated views.
